gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ (CLOSE) to traffic since the landslide.
gaps.hint: state continuing since a past point
gaps.explanation: 'Since' with a continuing state takes the present perfect passive: has been closed.

gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ by a locally trained architect.
gaps.explanation: 'Was designed by' — passive with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.
The results receive the action: 'will be announced'.

gaps.sentence: The markings ___ (see) with the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: cannot be + seen. The context (astronomy) implies impossibility.

gaps.sentence: By the time you read this, the treaty ___ (sign) by all twelve delegations.
gaps.explanation: 'By the time + present clause' with a future meaning takes the future perfect passive.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript is said ___ in a private vault for decades.
gaps.explanation: 'For decades' before now: perfect passive infinitive to have been + kept.

gaps.sentence: The ambush ___ (plan) by someone with intimate knowledge of the valley.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive (had been planned) stresses completion before the ambush; was planned is also acceptable.
